notes.title: New patch for METAL GEAR RISING: REVENGEANCE is now live!
notes.content:
A new patch for METAL GEAR RISING: REVENGEANCE went live this morning  (3/7/14) to correct some of the most common issues as reported by internal teams and fans. Including:

- Fixed issue where game would crash when resolution was adjusted at certain points in the game.
- Fixed crash that would occur when no "C Drive" was found.  Game no longer crashes, but saved data will not synchronize with Steam Cloud unless there is a "C Drive" on the system.
- Fixed bugs where Armstrong would not drop Repair Nanopaste and would not trigger the final QTE when framerate was set to less than 60fps.
